newsitem.title: UK: Proudfoot up after bullish newspaper report.
newsitem.headline: Proudfoot up after bullish newspaper report.

text.p: Shares in British management consultancy Proudfoot Plc soared in pre-opening trade on Monday after an upbeat report on the stock in Saturday's edition of the Daily Mail newspaper, dealers said. At 0820 GMT Proudfoot was quoted at 23 pence bid, up 7p on last Friday's close.
The Daily Mail report said Proudfoot's poor run since the early 1990s may have ended with last week's announcement of a 33 million stg loss for 1996.

That figure included a 37 million stg write-off linked to its disposal of Philip Crosby Associates, a firm it acquired in 1989, meaning Proudfoot would otherwise have turned in operating profits of around five million stg, the Mail said. Proudfoot shares hit a peak around 400p in 1991, its best year when profits reached 50 million stg. --Dan Lalor, London newsroom +44 171 542 7717
